items.title: RSA-896
items.title_zh: RSA-896
items.summary: A researcher reports factoring the RSA-896 challenge number with Claude, which was used to port CADO-NFS to GPUs and orchestrate up to 2,048 of them during idle time over a 10-day run totalling about 30 GPU-years. The author says the work does not affect RSA-2048 but shows RSA-1024 keys are vulnerable to actors with data-center-scale GPU fleets.

items.title: US Revokes Limits on Power Plants' Climate Pollution
items.title_zh: 美国撤销发电厂气候污染限制
items.summary: The US Environmental Protection Agency announced on September 14 that it is repealing limits on climate-warming pollution from coal- and gas-fired power plants, the country's second-largest source of greenhouse gas emissions.

items.title: AI and the Destruction of the Creative Commons
items.title_zh: AI 与创意公地的毁灭
items.summary: The author argues that AI has thrown out the four-decade equilibrium between software copyright protection and openness, recalling how typing in BASIC programs from magazines and writing REXX games for a BBS helped the author learn to program.

items.title: RSA-896
items.title_zh: RSA-896
items.summary: A researcher reports factoring the RSA-896 challenge number with Claude, which was used to port CADO-NFS to GPUs and orchestrate up to 2,048 of them during idle time over a 10-day run totalling about 30 GPU-years. The author says the work does not affect RSA-2048 but shows RSA-1024 keys are vulnerable to actors with data-center-scale GPU fleets.

items.title: The LLMentalist Effect (2023)
items.title_zh: LLMentalist 效应（2023）
items.summary: A 2023 essay, reposted on Hacker News, examines what it calls the "LLMentalist effect" in large language models.

items.title: Pirate Face Rescues LLM Models from Deletion
items.title_zh: Pirate Face 抢救被删除的 LLM 模型
items.summary: Pirate Face offers open models as checksum-verified magnet links, an approach it describes as censorship-resistant and kept alive by seeders.

items.title: ChatGPT now knows what you do on other websites via ad collector
items.title_zh: ChatGPT 通过广告收集器掌握你在其他网站的活动
items.summary: A write-up says OpenAI's ad collector at bzr.openai.com sets a cookie called __obi, scoped to .openai.com and tied to a user's ChatGPT account, which is then sent to OpenAI from ordinary websites that user visits. It adds that any company buying ads on ChatGPT installs the collector.

items.title: Samsung is expected to more than double output of its HBM4 and HBM4E DRAM
items.title_zh: 三星预计将把 HBM4 与 HBM4E DRAM 产量提高一倍以上
items.summary: Samsung Electronics is expected to more than double its HBM4 and HBM4E output next year, according to industry sources, which would lift glass carrier demand 2.5-fold.

items.title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Camera test
items.title_zh: Apple iPhone 18 Pro 相机测试
items.summary: DXOMARK's camera test gives the Apple iPhone 18 Pro a score of 172, citing improved dynamic range, stabilization and a variable aperture.

items.title: Spain orders blocks on Archive.today and its mirrors
items.title_zh: 西班牙下令封锁 Archive.today 及其镜像站
items.summary: Spain has ordered blocks on Archive.today and its mirrors, according to Reclaim The Net, which reports that no court ruling was required — only a complaint, a commission and a censorship protocol built for speed.

items.title: Why do we need human mathematicians anymore?
items.title_zh: 我们还需要人类数学家吗？
items.summary: An essay poses the question of why human mathematicians are still needed.

items.title: Qwen Image 2.1
items.title_zh: Qwen Image 2.1
items.summary: The Qwen Image 2.1 page describes capabilities spanning chat, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search, tool use and artifacts.

items.title: The senior engineer death spiral
items.title_zh: 资深工程师的死亡螺旋
items.summary: An essay examines a phenomenon the author calls the "senior engineer death spiral."

items.title: Sherline Tools Is Going Out of Business
items.title_zh: Sherline Tools 即将停业
items.summary: Sherline Tools, a US manufacturer known for precision lathes, mills, micro-machining accessories and small CNC machines, has announced that it is winding down manufacturing operations.

items.title: Singapore’s National Library Board offers micropayments to build reading habits
items.title_zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局用微支付培养阅读习惯
items.summary: Singapore's National Library Board runs ReadSG, which pays citizens virtual coins for logging daily reading time in an effort to curb phone use through small financial nudges.

items.title: Laya on Mac M4 CoreML Offline
items.title_zh: 在 Mac M4 上用 CoreML 离线运行 Laya
items.summary: A gist shows Laya running offline on a Mac M4 through CoreML and points to the laya-coreml repository.

items.title: I am often wrong
items.title_zh: 我经常犯错
items.summary: Under the title "I am often wrong," the author shares a note first sent to their team, hoping it will be useful to others building product in the age of AI.

items.title: US Revokes Limits on Power Plants' Climate Pollution
items.title_zh: 美国撤销发电厂气候污染限制
items.summary: The US Environmental Protection Agency announced on September 14 that it is repealing limits on climate-warming pollution from coal- and gas-fired power plants, the country's second-largest source of greenhouse gas emissions.

items.title: A Necessary History of the Oddest Letter: W
items.title_zh: 最古怪字母 W 的必要历史
items.summary: A literary history traces the letter W to the fifth-century collapse of the western Roman Empire, which disintegrated into a patchwork of new kingdoms and rulers.

items.title: The Hierarchy of Money
items.title_zh: 货币的层级
items.summary: An explainer uses a parable about villagers who adopt hard-to-collect gray stones as money to show how value becomes abstract and why supply matters.

items.title: MCP was always a bad idea?
items.title_zh: MCP 一直是个坏主意？
items.summary: The author argues that MCP was always a bad idea and says they are tired of pretending otherwise.

items.title: Frontier Labs Are Selling Garbage to Fools in Washington
items.title_zh: 前沿实验室正在向华盛顿的傻瓜兜售垃圾
items.summary: A Substack essay argues that frontier AI labs are selling "garbage" to fools in Washington.

items.title: Nobody pays for FOSS, we can force them to
items.title_zh: 没人愿意为 FOSS 付费，那我们就逼他们付
items.summary: The author argues that 30 years of voluntary funding have failed to pay open-source maintainers because asking does not scale, and proposes that registries already charging companies route a slice of that revenue automatically to maintainers.

items.title: MUNI Heritage Weekend in San Francisco
items.title_zh: 旧金山 MUNI 遗产周末
items.summary: The author recounts visiting San Francisco for Muni Heritage Weekend 2026 and spending three hours beside the tracks with a line-scan camera, photographing trams.

items.title: Bill to Ban Private Equity from Owning Medical Practices
items.title_zh: 禁止私募股权拥有医疗诊所的法案
items.summary: A proposed bill would ban private equity firms from owning medical practices.

items.title: AX – Google’s Open Agentic Orchestrator
items.title_zh: AX——Google 的开源智能体编排器
items.summary: Google's AX lets users declare an agentic task in YAML; it then sandboxes the task, wires up its workspace, fences its network and helps run it at scale.

items.title: What happened to the Snowden archive
items.title_zh: Snowden 档案后来怎样了
items.summary: The last document from the Snowden archive was published on 29 May 2019, after The Guardian, Der Spiegel, The New York Times, ProPublica and finally The Intercept wound down publishing; the piece also recounts how Snowden first approached journalists in late 2012.

items.title: Haleclipse/CometixCode
items.title_zh: Haleclipse/CometixCode：Claude Code 终端界面的非官方 Rust 重实现
items.summary: An unofficial Rust reimplementation of Anthropic's Claude Code terminal UI, built on the iocraft library.

items.title: driceroland/Search
items.title_zh: driceroland/Search：Office Commun 的轻量 macOS WebKit 浏览器
items.summary: A small, fast WebKit browser for macOS from Office Commun, written in Swift.

items.title: Inkloom-art/inkloom
items.title_zh: Inkloom-art/inkloom：专为标志设计打造的 AI 模型
items.summary: Inkloom offers specialised AI models for logo design: a brand-analysis model turns a business into constraints, typography and symbol models construct the mark, and a composition engine produces lockups and clear-space rules. Early access is open.

items.title: RubinLabs26/ISpotify
items.title_zh: RubinLabs26/ISpotify：本地优先的桌面音乐应用
items.summary: A local-first desktop app for Windows and Linux that handles music search, playlists, downloads and playback, written in Python.

items.title: penso/herdr-gpui
items.title_zh: penso/herdr-gpui：Herdr 的原生跨平台客户端
items.summary: A native client for Herdr on macOS, Linux and Windows, built with Rust and GPUI, for viewing terminal sessions, workspaces, Git worktrees and agent activity through a local Herdr daemon.

items.title: maanHimself/OpenDLSS-NR
items.title_zh: maanHimself/OpenDLSS-NR：与 NVIDIA DLSS 5 逐位一致的 Vulkan 重实现
items.summary: A Vulkan reimplementation of NVIDIA's DLSS 5 Neural Rendering network, described as bit-exact against the original, written in JavaScript.

items.title: 3zwr1/AMD-NR---OptiScaler
items.title_zh: 3zwr1/AMD-NR---OptiScaler：在 AMD GPU 上启用 DLSS 5 神经渲染
items.summary: Brings DLSS 5 Neural Rendering to AMD GPUs inside OptiScaler, with model interleave, residual composition, XeSS frame generation up to 6X and FSR Ray Regeneration, written in C++.

items.title: wuyoscar/jev-skill
items.title_zh: wuyoscar/jev-skill：Jev 用例、工作流与智能体技能合集
items.summary: A collection of Jev use cases, workflows and agent skills, written in Python.

items.title: atlas-vtt/atlas-vtt
items.title_zh: atlas-vtt/atlas-vtt：Obsidian 的开源虚拟桌面
items.summary: An open-source virtual tabletop for Obsidian with battle maps, tokens, fog of war, dice, initiative and a separate player view, written in TypeScript.

items.title: HaikuS2S: A Cascaded System For Responding In Verse
items.title_zh: HaikuS2S：用于以俳句作答的级联系统
items.summary: The paper presents HaikuS2S, a cascaded system combining automatic speech recognition, LLM-generated haiku, and text-to-speech fine-tuned on both prose and custom haiku datasets to produce speech that respects haiku's 5-7-5 structure and line-ending pauses. Evaluation on emotion similarity, speech quality, and prosody alignment shows significant prosody and tonal alignment gains for the fine-tuned systems, especially the one trained on both general poetry and haiku, while emotion similarity stays similar across systems.

items.title: XYEval: Agents say yes to bad advice
items.title_zh: XYEval：智能体对糟糕建议说“是”
items.summary: The paper introduces XYEval, a meta-evaluation framework that transforms existing benchmarks into XY-problem tests of whether agents resist plausible but misleading user suggestions and explain their reasoning, evaluated across five models and six benchmark suites. It reports relative performance drops of up to 46.7% under XY mutation, shows performance falls further with a pedantic user, and finds that a simple system-instruction baseline offers only partial mitigation.

items.title: Time-Incremental Continued Pretraining of LLMs: Knowledge Updates Without Catastrophic Forgetting
items.title_zh: 大语言模型的时间增量式持续预训练：无灾难性遗忘的知识更新
items.summary: The paper studies time-incremental continued pretraining on FineWeb-Edu dumps drawn from after each model's knowledge cutoff across six open-weight models from the OLMo2, Llama-3.1/3.2, and Gemma-3-1B families at 1B-8B scale. It reports that new knowledge is acquired without catastrophic forgetting, that a thirteen-task macro-average stays within 0.01 of the base model, that data quality dominates quantity, and that LoRA at sufficient rank matches full continued pretraining.

items.title: Increasing Skill Level Recruits Deeper Attention Layers in a Frozen Chess Transformer
items.title_zh: 棋力提升会调动冻结的国际象棋 Transformer 中更深的注意力层
items.summary: The paper ablates every attention head of the Maia-3 chess transformer at every Elo from 700 to 2500, exploiting the model's skill input to vary conditioning without changing weights. It finds that higher skill monotonically pushes the causal center of mass of computation deeper for every piece and move type measured, that the migration is much larger for specific tactics such as knight forks, and that it consists of deeper heads being recruited for specialized computations while one shared shallow head keeps a roughly constant contribution.

items.title: Matched-Input Estimates Differ in Sign Across Architectures: Auditing EEG Foundation Models on Motor Imagery
items.title_zh: 匹配输入下的估计在不同架构间符号相反：对运动想象 EEG 基础模型的审计
items.summary: The paper audits LaBraM and CBraMod on motor imagery under a validation-locked protocol and finds that every supervised comparator beats every foundation-model configuration on four-class BCI Competition IV-2a, while the separation does not reproduce on two-class BNCI2014-004. Retraining three supervised architectures on the broadband inputs used by the foundation models yields matched-input accuracy differences of opposite sign across architectures, though none of the individual terms is significant after multiple-comparison correction at n = 9.

items.title: Echo State Network (ESN) for Signal Recovery in RF-Impaired IBFD MIMO Systems
items.title_zh: 用于射频损伤 IBFD MIMO 系统信号恢复的回声状态网络
items.summary: The paper proposes a two-stage echo state network scheme for in-band full-duplex MIMO in which a frozen ESN is trained offline to characterize the static self-interference path and an adaptive ESN, updated online via recursive least squares on sparse pilot symbols, tracks the time-varying signal-of-interest path under RF impairments. Simulations show the approach outperforms blind source separation, LSTM, and GRU baselines in both efficiency and signal-of-interest recovery.
